blocks.name: hero-1
blocks.title: Hero 1
blocks.description: Hero section with announcement card on the left and a 2x2 stats grid on the right (active builds · trusted by · deploys sparkline · testimonial). Same structure across themes.

blocks.name: hero-2
blocks.title: Hero 2
blocks.description: Centered hero with announcement pill, large headline, dual CTAs and a six-logo trust strip. Single-column composition that scales from mobile to desktop.

blocks.name: hero-3
blocks.title: Hero 3
blocks.description: Developer-flavored split hero — headline, dual CTAs and an avatar social-proof strip on the left, code-window mockup with traffic-light dots and a syntax-highlighted snippet on the right.

blocks.name: hero-4
blocks.title: Hero 4
blocks.description: Image-led split hero — announcement pill, headline, subtitle, dual CTAs and avatar social proof on the left; product photo with a floating stat card (icon + value + caption) anchored bottom-right on the right.

blocks.name: about-1
blocks.title: About 1
blocks.description: Editorial about section — eyebrow + headline on the left, two-paragraph mission and CTA link on the right, anchored by a four-up stats strip below (founded · customers · countries · team).

blocks.name: about-2
blocks.title: About 2
blocks.description: Image-led split about — eyebrow, headline, mission paragraph, two inline stats and dual CTAs on the left; portrait team photo with a floating 'Est.' badge on the right.

blocks.name: pricing-1
blocks.title: Pricing 1
blocks.description: Three-tier pricing grid with centered header — Starter, Pro (featured with 'Most popular' badge and inverted card), Enterprise. Each tier shows price, period, description, primary CTA and a 5-item feature list with check icons.

blocks.name: navbar-1
blocks.title: Navbar 1
blocks.description: Sticky top navigation — brand + version badge on the left, primary links in the middle (md+), secondary auth link and primary CTA on the right. Mobile collapses to brand + CTA only.

blocks.name: footer-1
blocks.title: Footer 1
blocks.description: Multi-column footer — brand block with description and three social icons on the left (lg:col-span-2), three link columns on the right (product · company · resources). Bottom bar with copyright and legal links.

blocks.name: features-1
blocks.title: Features 1
blocks.description: Centered eyebrow + headline + subtitle, followed by a 6-card grid of features (icon in muted square · title · description). Three columns on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile. Six lucide icons available via the `icon` enum (zap, shield, code, layers, sparkles, chart).

blocks.name: cta-1
blocks.title: CTA 1
blocks.description: Centered call-to-action card with inverted primary background, subtle radial-gradient overlay, eyebrow pill, large headline, subtitle, and dual buttons (primary inverted + ghost). Designed to anchor the bottom of a landing page.
